disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration contained in this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in practice or in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of the profession or practicing fraud or deceit, either alone or as a conspirator, in obtaining a license, certification or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony or misdemeanor relating to a health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony or being convicted of a misdemeanor relating to a health profession or receiving probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an Accelerated Rehabilitative Disposition in the disposition of felony charges

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or other authorization to practice the profession revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license or other authorization refused, revoked or suspended by a proper licensing authority of another state, territory, possession or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, addiction, mental incompetency, or felony conviction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice the profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, addiction to drugs or alcohol, having been convicted of a felonious act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or a lawful order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or violating a lawful order of the board previously entered by the board in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining connection with or aiding an unlicensed person to practice a profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this act or regulations of the board or knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unlicensed person to practice a profession contrary to this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner presenting an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in such manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.

insurance_required.quote: A licensee under this section, practicing in this Commonwealth, shall maintain a level of professional liability insurance coverage in the minimum amount of $1,000,000 per occurrence or claims made.

definition_quote.value: The provision of services to individuals, couples, families and organizations by one or more appropriately trained individuals to address the physical and psychological issues associated with the occurrence or risk of occurrence of a genetic disorder, birth defect or genetically influenced condition or disease in an individual or a family.
definition_quote.quote: The provision of services to individuals, couples, families and organizations by one or more appropriately trained individuals to address the physical and psychological issues associated with the occurrence or risk of occurrence of a genetic disorder, birth defect or genetically influenced condition or disease in an individual or a family.

value: Obtain and evaluate individual and family medical histories to determine genetic risk
Discuss features, natural history, means of diagnosis, genetic and environmental factors and management of risk
Identify and coordinate genetic laboratory tests and other diagnostic studies
Integrate genetic laboratory test results with personal and family medical history to assess and communicate risk factors
Explain the clinical implications of genetic laboratory tests and other diagnostic studies and their results
Evaluate the client's or family's responses and provide client-centered counseling
Provide written documentation of medical, genetic and counseling information
methods_authorized.quote: A genetic counselor may provide genetic counseling to clients, which includes: (i) Obtain and evaluate individual and family medical histories to determine genetic risk for genetic or medical conditions and diseases in a patient and other family members.

certifying_bodies_accepted.quote: The person has passed the examination for certification as a genetic counselor by ABGC or ABMG or has passed the examination for certification as a Ph.D. medical geneticist by ABMG, as approved by the board.

active_candidate_status_recognized.quote: the board may issue a provisional license to practice genetic counseling to a person who meets all of the qualifications for licensure except for the certification requirement of subsection (e)(4), provided that the person has been granted active candidate status establishing eligibility to sit for the next available certification examination by ABGC or ABMG.

temporary_license_exam_attempt_limit.quote: Under no circumstances shall a person continue to practice on a provisional license upon notification that the person has not passed the examination within two examination cycles after receiving the provisional license.

temporary_license_duration_years.quote: A provisional license shall allow the person to practice under the supervision of a genetic counselor or a licensed physician until the person receives certification from ABGC or ABMG or two examination cycles have elapsed, whichever comes first.

temporary_license_supervisor_types.quote: A provisional license shall allow the person to practice under the supervision of a genetic counselor or a licensed physician

medicine_practice_exclusion.quote: Nothing in this subsection shall be construed to authorize a genetic counselor to diagnose, test or treat any genetic disease or condition or other disease or condition.

referral_to_physician_required_when_outs.quote: if a genetic counselor finds any indication of a disease or condition that requires diagnosis and treatment outside the scope of practice defined in this section, the genetic counselor shall refer the client to a licensed physician or appropriate health care practitioner.

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A person employed by the Federal Government to provide genetic counseling while in the discharge of the person's official duties.

phd_medical_geneticist_pathway.quote: The person has passed the examination for certification as a genetic counselor by ABGC or ABMG or has passed the examination for certification as a Ph.D. medical geneticist by ABMG, as approved by the board.

accrediting_body_for_training_program.quote: master's degree or doctoral degree in human genetics or genetic counseling from an ABGC-accredited or ABMG-accredited educational program

continuing_education_hours_per_period.quote: at least 30 hours of continuing education as approved by the board

physician_member_on_governing_body.quote: nine members appointed by the Governor, one of whom shall be a physician assistant, seven of whom shall be medical doctors with unrestricted licenses to practice medicine and surgery

grandfathering_provision.quote: For a period of three years after the effective date of this section, the board may issue a license to a person who meets all of the qualifications for licensure except for the requirements of subsection (e)(3) and (4)
